requirement: Another authorized surgeon adds or removes a required affirmation; cases.gate_affirmed_at updates or clears transactionally and callers cannot spoof it.
evidence_mode: Current-hash audit of the fresh and populated-upgrade PostgreSQL campaigns; no redundant live rerun.

observed_behavior.remove: After surgeon A completed all four required affirmations, surgeon B removed plan; the authoritative snapshot had three kinds and null gate_affirmed_at/gate_affirmed_by.
observed_behavior.add: A same-case concurrent campaign had surgeons A and B add the four required kinds; the authoritative summary matched the latest committed affirmation timestamp and actor.
observed_behavior.spoof_refusal: Restricted runtime and direct administrator attempts to set gate_affirmed_at/gate_affirmed_by were refused. Controlled summary-trigger disablement allowed the synthetic spoof, then rollback restored the guard.
observed_behavior.atomicity: Command, affirmation, audit and derived summary share the PostgreSQL transaction; forced audit failure preserved prior counts and snapshot.

prerequisites: Existing Compose PostgreSQL service and configured administrative credential were available.
Rust 1.97.1 and the single-writer workspace build directory were available.
All records were synthetic and all disposable resources were cleaned.
unverified: Production deployment, browser UI and physical devices remain outside this PostgreSQL acceptance proof.
